semiconductor_relevance: High — Process Insights specializes in gas analysis and measurement solutions critical for maintaining gas quality in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Process Insights provides advanced analytical solutions for the semiconductor industry, focusing on high-purity gas analysis to ensure quality and detect impurities. Their offerings include maintenance-free gas analyzers that utilize Cavity Ring-Down Spectroscopy (CRDS) technology for continuous quality control in gas monitoring.
capabilities: Cavity Ring-Down Spectroscopy (CRDS) gas analyzers for trace oxygen measurement
Continuous quality control (CQC) monitoring for bulk gases

regional_presence.Japan: Process Insights operates in Japan, handling CRDS technology from Tiger Optics.
